description: Lower the number of characters of a successful Bash or PowerShell command's output that Claude receives inline; longer output is saved to a file and Claude receives a preview and the file's path.
source: Claude Code settings reference, bashOutputMaxChars: characters of a successful Bash or PowerShell command's output that Claude receives inline; past the limit the output is saved to a file and Claude receives a short preview and the path; any settings file; clamped to 4000 to 128000; default unset (30,000 inline); v2.1.261 or later. Tools reference, Output limits: preview of up to the first 2,000 characters; with the setting, BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH is ignored, and that variable only sizes the read-back window, not the inline ceiling. Read 2026-11-12. Hive plan section 4.
